coverage.reason: Repair hosted-checkout handoff in the shared live/test client, preserve the same idempotent order when popup navigation is blocked or lost, and provide visible real links plus same-tab return. Browser coverage exercises the actual Shop/dialog at desktop and landscape-mobile sizes, blocked/throwing/closed/silent popup paths, retry recovery, terminal states, hostile URL rejection, account-switch isolation, and no client wallet mutations. Existing live/test validators protect the provider URL, quote and API contracts consumed by this UI. No server-authoritative code or schema changes; no emulator suite is needed.

Document the observed read-only diagnostic and checkout recovery behavior, distinguish historical setup from current local operation, and explain player requirements. Runtime behavior is covered by the adjacent UI validation group.
